oracle.rationale: CommandReaderBuilder::build invokes spawn on its &mut std::process::Command parameter. The Rust standard library defines Command::spawn as spawning a child process. Other unknown paths cannot erase this positive witness.

cases.limitation: Only this exact retained file under the authored file-scoped fixture is governed; no whole-repository conclusion.

oracle.rationale: from_bounds invokes Iterator::size_hint on an arbitrary externally implemented generic Iterator. No contract bounds its filesystem effects. A no-write conclusion for every possible implementation is unjustified; reachable unresolved behavior must remain uncertain.

cases.limitation: Open-trait uncertainty is a required outcome, not a favorable negative control or a sample of real-world false positives.
